mainEntity.name: What is the MOQ for custom paper bags?

acceptedAnswer.text: MOQ depends on size, material and printing requirements. iColorPack supports low MOQ custom packaging projects and can suggest the most cost-effective option after receiving your size and quantity.

mainEntity.name: Can I print my logo on the packaging?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We support CMYK printing, Pantone color, foil stamping, embossing, debossing, spot UV and other custom logo finishes.
